packageNote: Notion task pages are blank except for database properties. Tests describe spectator-observable behavior for later implementation. This file is not executed by vp test.

relatedOutsidePackage.title: Mostrar rankings y premios por posición en portal público
relatedOutsidePackage.reason: QA in this package depends on rankings portal UI. Statistics backend already exists on main.

tests.subject: GET public competition home
tests.given: A competition with status published, two approved teams, and no session cookie
tests.when: An anonymous client GET the public portada resource by publicId
tests.then: Status is 200. Body.name equals the competition name. Body has no organizationId, createdByActorId, or creationKey.

tests.subject: GET public competition home unpublished
tests.given: A competition with status draft that contains internal rules and an invitation token in the operator record
tests.when: An anonymous client GET the public portada resource for that id
tests.then: Status is 404. Body is the standard api error shape. Body does not include the draft name, token, or rules blob.

tests.subject: GetPublicStandingsUseCase
tests.given: An official standing snapshot after results.official-result-approved with teamIds Barranco and Surquillo
tests.when: The public standings use case runs with no actorId
tests.then: Rows are [{position:1, teamPublicName:"Barranco FC", points:3, ...}, ...] in that order. Each row has no organizationId.

tests.subject: GetPublicStandingsUseCase empty
tests.given: A published competition with zero approved official results
tests.when: The public standings use case runs
tests.then: The result is an empty row list or a typed empty snapshot, not an error, and not a private statistics DTO.

tests.subject: GET public calendar
tests.given: A published fixture with one scheduled encounter and a stored EA candidate list on that encounter
tests.when: An anonymous client GET the public calendario resource
tests.then: The encounter appears with public team names and scheduledStartAt. The body has no candidates array, no provider payload, and no fixturePlanId requirement in the spectator URL.

tests.subject: GET public bracket omitted for league
tests.given: A published competition with format league and no knockout stage
tests.when: An anonymous client GET the public bracket resource
tests.then: Status is 404. The body does not invent bye scores.

tests.subject: GET public teams and players
tests.given: A published competition whose roster rows include gameAccountId, playerProfileId, and displayName null
tests.when: An anonymous client GET public equipos and jugadores
tests.then: Players render a public display name fallback. Body has no gameAccountId, no invitation token, no email.

tests.subject: Public routes skip service auth
tests.given: No Authorization header and no X-Futrob-Actor-Id
tests.when: An anonymous client GET a public portal path
tests.then: Status is not 401 with code api.unauthorized. Meta-style service auth is not required.

tests.subject: Private statistics path stays closed
tests.given: No service auth
tests.when: A client GET /api/v1/organizations/org-1/competitions/comp-1/rankings
tests.then: Status is 401. The public suite does not weaken this gate.

tests.subject: Public projection allowlist
tests.given: A statistics RankingSnapshot row {playerProfileId:"profile-1", teamId:"team-1", value:7, matchesPlayed:3, minutes:270} plus a raw EA observation {payload:{secret:1}} in game-data
tests.when: The public rankings mapper (once the rankings portal API exists) builds the spectator DTO
tests.then: The DTO contains position, public player name, public team name, value, matchesPlayed, minutes, kind, eligibility. It does not contain playerProfileId, payload, or secret.

tasks.title: [UI] Portada, calendario, tabla, bracket, equipos, jugadores

tests.subject: Anonymous portal portada
tests.given: Public API returns a published competition named Copa Barranco
tests.when: A guest opens the public portada route without a session
tests.then: The document shows Copa Barranco in the competition header. The page is not redirected to /login.

tests.subject: No admin chrome
tests.given: The same published competition
tests.when: A guest views portada, calendario, tabla, equipos, and jugadores
tests.then: There is no authenticated sidebar, no Publicar competición, no Disputas, no Analíticas, no captain selection CTA.

tests.subject: Tabs match format
tests.given: Public home says format league
tests.when: The portal header renders tabs
tests.then: Bracket is omitted. Calendario, tabla, equipos, and jugadores are present.

tests.subject: Empty standings
tests.given: Public standings rows are []
tests.when: The guest opens tabla
tests.then: An empty state is visible. It is not a 403 and not a spinner that never ends.

tests.subject: Accessible bracket list
tests.given: A knockout public bracket with one bye
tests.when: The guest opens bracket
tests.then: A visual bracket and an equivalent list exist. The bye row has no fake score.

tests.subject: Unpublished 404
tests.given: Public API returns 404 for a draft id
tests.when: A guest opens that public URL
tests.then: A recoverable not-found panel is shown. Draft setup copy is not shown.

tests.subject: es and en chrome
tests.given: Locale es then locale en
tests.when: The portal header renders
tests.then: Tab labels come from message keys, not hardcoded mixed language. Both catalogs define the keys.

tests.subject: Deep link tab
tests.given: A typed public URL for the tabla tab
tests.when: The guest opens that URL
tests.then: Tabla is the current tab (aria-current=page) and standings content is shown.

tasks.title: [Feature] Share / OG meta / deep links públicos

tests.subject: Competition OG title
tests.given: Public home name is Copa Barranco
tests.when: SSR renders the public portada head
tests.then: A meta tag property=og:title has content Copa Barranco or a string that starts with that name. It is not the site-wide app.title alone.

tests.subject: OG image stays public
tests.given: The competition has only the default public image
tests.when: SSR renders head
tests.then: og:image is a public URL. The HTML has no session cookie instructions and no signed private R2 query string that authorizes other objects.

tests.subject: Draft is not indexable
tests.given: Public API 404 for a draft
tests.when: SSR renders that URL
tests.then: Status is 404. No og:title equals the draft internal name.

tests.subject: Encounter deep link is public
tests.given: A published encounter with stored EA candidates
tests.when: A guest opens the public encounter URL
tests.then: The page shows the official or scheduled public projection. It does not show candidate rows or captain actions.

tests.subject: Share URL has no token
tests.given: An invitation token tok_secret exists for the competition
tests.when: The portal copy-link or canonical URL is built
tests.then: The URL does not contain tok_secret or a raw invitation path segment.

tests.subject: Crawler HTML has no EA payload
tests.given: Game-data has a raw observation payload {clubsInfo:[{clubId:"ea-1"}]} for a club in the competition
tests.when: A crawler fetches the public portada HTML without executing client JS beyond SSR
tests.then: The HTML does not contain clubsInfo or ea-1 as a raw payload dump.

tasks.title: [QA] No filtrar datos privados ni payloads EA

tests.subject: Organizer versus spectator bodies
tests.given: The same published competition. Organizer session can read participants, disputes, and rankings with playerProfileId. Anonymous public GET exists
tests.when: Both responses are fetched
tests.then: Public JSON is not equal to the private DTO. Public JSON has no disputes, no playerProfileId, no gameAccountId. Public JSON does include the official table points for Barranco FC.

tests.subject: Candidates never public
tests.given: GET /encounters/enc-1/candidates returns a provider candidate for an authenticated captain
tests.when: Anonymous GET any public encounter resource for enc-1
tests.then: The public body has no candidates key and no raw match payload. Status is 200 with public projection or 404, never the candidates document.

tests.subject: Raw observation payload absent
tests.given: A RawProviderObservation {payload:{secretMatch: true}, endpointKey:"clubs-matches"} is stored
tests.when: Anonymous GET every public portal JSON resource for that competition
tests.then: No resource body contains secretMatch, endpointKey, or payload as an object field.

tests.subject: Rankings eligibility on portal
tests.given: A player with 2 matches and 50 percent team minutes, and a player with 3 matches and 7 goals
tests.when: Anonymous GET public rankings kind=scorer (after rankings portal API exists)
tests.then: The ineligible player is absent. The eligible player is position 1 with value 7 and a public name.

tests.subject: All ranking kinds
tests.given: Rebuilt snapshots for scorer, assister, rating, mvp, and goalkeeper
tests.when: Anonymous GET public rankings without kind filter
tests.then: The five kinds are present. Premium analytics fields such as percentiles are absent.

tests.subject: Portal HTML anti-leak
tests.given: SSR of portada, tabla, and rankings tabs with the same fixtures as qa-01
tests.when: The HTML is searched
tests.then: It contains Copa Barranco. It does not contain INTERNAL_JOB_SECRET, dispute text "protesta privada", or payload JSON.

tests.subject: Two-organization isolation
tests.given: Org A published competition A1 and org B published competition B1
tests.when: Anonymous GET public resources for A1
tests.then: Bodies never include B1 names or ids.

tests.subject: Tokens absent
tests.given: An active competition invitation token and a roster invitation token
tests.when: Anonymous GET public resources
tests.then: Neither token string appears in JSON or Set-Cookie.

tests.subject: Public GET is cacheable
tests.given: Anonymous GET of a public portada JSON or HTML resource
tests.when: The response is inspected
tests.then: cache-control contains public and an s-maxage or max-age integer greater than 0. It is not no-store.

tests.subject: Private JSON stays no-store
tests.given: Authenticated GET /api/v1/organizations/org-1/competitions/comp-1/rankings
tests.when: The response is inspected
tests.then: cache-control is no-store.

tests.subject: Session cookie does not poison public cache
tests.given: A guest cache entry for publicId C1. An organizer then GET the same public URL with a session cookie
tests.when: A later anonymous GET publicId C1 is served
tests.then: The body is still the sanitized spectator projection. It does not contain organizer-only keys from the cookie request.

tests.subject: Public response has no Set-Cookie
tests.given: Anonymous GET public portada
tests.when: Headers are inspected
tests.then: Set-Cookie is absent. Authorization is not required.

tests.subject: Auth routes remain uncached
tests.given: GET /api/auth/get-session or the auth proxy
tests.when: Headers are inspected
tests.then: cache-control is no-store. Public cache config did not change this.

tests.subject: Rebuild invalidates or expires official reads
tests.given: Public standings cached as Barranco FC 3 points. Then an approved official result rebuilds standings to 6 points and emits statistics.competition-stats-rebuilt
tests.when: A guest GET public tabla after TTL or after explicit purge
tests.then: The body shows 6 points, not 3.
